integrationReview.reason: Wiki holds synthesized ecosystem knowledge; read and ingest must be identity-scoped, not public
integrationReview.contract: RS256 service identity + user roles per SERVICE_IDENTITY_CONSUMER_STANDARD.md
integrationReview.failureMode: Requests rejected with 401 when token invalid or Auth unreachable; no anonymous fallback
integrationReview.validation: Unauthenticated request to /query returns 401; valid service token returns 200

integrationReview.reason: Wiki page metadata, ingest log and citation index need durable relational state beyond the container
integrationReview.contract: Dedicated database jarvis with least-privilege role jarvis_app
integrationReview.failureMode: Service fails readiness when database unreachable; never starts with an empty fallback store
integrationReview.validation: Readiness probe fails on bad DSN; migrations apply with migrate deploy

integrationReview.reason: Ingest and lint are low-frequency batch operations; LWC uses its own embedded index and needs no shared cache or queue

integrationReview.contract: HTTP POST to logging-microservice with service=jarvis
integrationReview.failureMode: Log delivery is fire-and-forget and must never throw into the request path; failures degrade to stderr
integrationReview.validation: Ingest and query operations appear in logging-microservice for service jarvis

integrationReview.reason: Lint findings (contradictions, stale claims, orphan pages) must reach the owner or they go unread
integrationReview.contract: HTTP POST to notifications-microservice, PLAIN parse mode
integrationReview.failureMode: Notification failure is logged and never blocks or fails the lint run
integrationReview.validation: A seeded lint contradiction produces one owner notification

integrationReview.reason: Ingest, query synthesis and lint are LLM operations; model access is centralized in ai-microservice, never a direct provider key in jarvis
integrationReview.configuration: AI_SERVICE_URL from configmap; no provider API key held by jarvis
integrationReview.failureMode: Ingest/query return 503 and change no wiki state when AI is unavailable; partial pages are never committed
integrationReview.validation: Ingest of a fixture source produces a wiki page; AI outage leaves wiki byte-identical

integrationReview.reason: Internal knowledge service with no billing surface
Raw sources (PDF, images, attachments) are immutable inputs and must not live on container disk
integrationReview.contract: Private MinIO bucket jarvis-raw with bucket-scoped credentials
integrationReview.configuration: MINIO_ENDPOINT, MINIO_ACCESS_KEY, MINIO_SECRET_KEY, MINIO_BUCKET via ESO
integrationReview.failureMode: Ingest fails loudly when the bucket is unreachable; no silent local-disk fallback
integrationReview.validation: Upload then retrieve a fixture source; credentials reach no other bucket

integrationReview.reason: RunLayer is the sole task authority and calls jarvis synchronously over HTTP; no async fan-out is in approved scope

integrationReview.failureMode: Git remains authoritative when retrieval is unavailable or unconfident
integrationReview.validation: Distinctive project phrase resolves to the owning repository path

integrationReview.reason: The wiki is a compounding artifact; losing it loses all accumulated synthesis, which cannot be re-derived cheaply
integrationReview.contract: Scheduled backup of jarvis database and jarvis-raw bucket
integrationReview.failureMode: A missed backup window raises an alert rather than passing silently
integrationReview.validation: Restore rehearsal reproduces wiki pages and raw sources
